title: Multi-round contrastive recursion needs provenance hygiene at every hop
summary: Recursive PPC rounds materialize each auto_advance winner onto a copied base; judgment (human_gate) must never auto-progress.
hint_triggers: Multi-round recursion: auto_advance winner materializes onto a copy of the base (never mutate scenarioDir) and becomes next round base; keep_base/decline stop; human_gate halts with blind recommendation — judgment never auto-progresses. Budget identity: declared rounds -> expected probes; unique labels BEFORE counting. Review lessons: label a selector by what it is (lambda=heuristic not llm); surface propose_meta per round or stub degradation is invisible; round-prefix adopted labels; predict proposed labels upfront; document cumulative rejected semantics.
